groups.defect: Collective members' destination calendars are dropped because optional-chained push does nothing when the organizer's destinationCalendar is null.
groups.rationale: Both report the same null initialization and no-op push, resolved by ensuring an array before appending.

groups.defect: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar when the destination array is absent or empty.
groups.rationale: All six identify the same unsafe integration access in EventManager; restoring its null guard addresses every report.

groups.defect: Google updateEvent and deleteEvent both replace the destination-calendar fallback with a lookup against the already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the intended target calendar.
groups.rationale: The same faulty predicate is repeated in two methods, each requiring an edit. Several suggestions explicitly report both occurrences, linking the update-only and delete-only reports.

groups.defect: Non-calendar booking references lose their video credentialId because the mapping explicitly assigns undefined.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same mapping regression; their different downstream examples do not change the defect.

groups.defect: The integration-type creation branch omits destination.externalId, leaving the persisted booking reference without externalCalendarId.
groups.rationale: Both report the missing argument in the same createEvent call. The Google fallback failures cited downstream are consequences, not additional defects reported by these suggestions.
